name: elagoht/live
description: A collage plugin that keeps parts of a page current in the browser: it serves a small client script that refreshes the fragments a page opened with WithFragmentPath, on an interval or when the server pushes a change over an event stream.

templateFunctions.name: liveClient
templateFunctions.doc: The collage-live client script. Put it in the layout's `<head>`; elements marked `data-collage-fragment` are then kept current.

attributes.name: data-collage-fragment
attributes.doc: collage-live: the fragment path whose answer fills the element.

attributes.name: data-collage-interval
attributes.doc: collage-live: fetch the fragment on this interval (`500ms`, `2s`, `1m`).

attributes.name: data-collage-push
attributes.doc: collage-live: take the fragment from the stream when the server pushes it.

attributes.name: data-collage-swap
attributes.doc: collage-live: `morph` patches the DOM in place, so a focused input keeps what is typed.

attributes.name: data-collage-transition
attributes.doc: collage-live: put each answer in inside a view transition, unless the reader prefers reduced motion.

attributes.name: data-collage-target
attributes.doc: collage-live: on a form, submit with fetch and put the answer into this element.

collage-live client.description: collage-live: the client script, in the layout's head

collage-live section.description: collage-live: an element kept current from a fragment path

config.description: A collage plugin that keeps parts of a page current in the browser: it serves a small client script that refreshes the fragments a page opened with WithFragmentPath, on an interval or when the server pushes a change over an event stream.

keepAlive.description: KeepAlive is how often an idle stream sends a comment, so a proxy that closes quiet connections leaves it open. Default 25s.

maxFragments.description: MaxFragments caps how many fragments one stream may watch. Default 32.

maxStreamAge.description: MaxStreamAge closes a stream after it has been open this long, and the client reconnects at once. A stream renders with the cookies it was opened with, so a reader who signed out elsewhere keeps receiving what the old cookie reads until it reconnects; this bounds how long. Nothing is lost — the reconnect sends what changed. Zero, the default, never closes one.

noStream.description: NoStream turns the event stream off. The client then only polls: an element marked data-collage-push without an interval is polled every five seconds.

prefix.description: Prefix is where the client and the stream are served: the client at <prefix>client/client.js, the stream at <prefix>stream/. It begins and ends with a slash. Default "/_live/".
